channel.title: Swansea Labour news
channel.description: Stories from Swansea Labour, for the Swansea Labour Councillors Facebook page

item.title: Labour council lands Becky Hill as first headliner for Tunes on the Bay 2027
item.description:
BRIT Award winner Becky Hill will headline Friday 30 April 2027 on Swansea Bay Beach as Labour's council brings Tunes on the Bay back for a third year.
#SwanseaBay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour-backed Multibank brings Christmas toys to Swansea families
item.description:
A special delivery of toys from Amazon has arrived at Multibank Cymru, which Swansea's Labour council helped to found and funds every year, to reach local families before Christmas.
#Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council moves to create 14 new nature reserves across Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is bringing forward 14 new Local Nature Reserves, from Port Eynon's dunes to the Mumbles coast, creating the largest network of its kind in Wales.
#SwanseaBay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour #Nature #LocalNatureReserve

item.title: Labour council's free Spooks in the City draws thousands to Swansea city centre
item.description:
Thousands packed St David's Place on Halloween for Spooks in the City: Día de los Muertos, a free celebration of Mexican culture put on by Swansea's Labour council with ILA-Wales.
#Castle #CityCentre #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's storm drain upgrade to protect Killay from flooding
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is installing an overflow drainage system at Killay Square to stop the junction flooding in heavy rain. Work starts on November 16.
#Killay #Dunvant #Flooding #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Dyfatty anti-social behaviour reports down over 37% as Labour council takes lead
item.description:
Anti-social behaviour reports in Dyfatty have dropped by over 37%. Swansea's Labour council now oversees the next phase of the Building a Better Dyfatty project.
#Castle #CommunitySafety #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council puts plans for 57 city centre homes at Porth Copr on show
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council invites residents to view early plans for 7 Porth Copr, with 57 apartments, cafés, restaurants and a new courtyard called Frog Yard, at Y Storfa on 2 November.
#Castle #Housing #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council puts extra resources into clearing Swansea's autumn leaves
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has cleansing teams and leaf-clearing machines out across the city to keep drains and footpaths clear, and is asking residents to report large build-ups.
#CleanerSwansea #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour takes forward plans for modern new learning spaces at Gowerton School
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is taking forward plans, costing in excess of £47m, to give Gowerton School pupils modern new classrooms and improved facilities.
#Gowerton #Schools #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council fills 5,656 potholes this year as £14m roads programme rolls out
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has filled 5,656 potholes since January as part of a £14m programme to improve the city's roads, and is asking residents to have their say in a survey closing on 2 November.
#Roads #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council invites residents to help shape the future of Gower
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council wants residents' views on the draft Gower Partnership Plan, which sets out how Gower's landscape, wildlife and heritage will be protected. The online survey closes at noon on 4 November 2026.
#HaveYourSay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's libraries lend out Wintering Well boxes to beat the winter blues
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is offering free Wintering Well Boxes to borrow from seven libraries, each with a daylight lamp, activity ideas and an online course to help residents stay well this winter.
#Libraries #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour's Bascule Bridge restoration gathers pace on the River Tawe
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is pressing ahead with the restoration of the 117-year-old Bascule Bridge, which will return next year as a walking and cycling route over the River Tawe.
#Landore #Heritage #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council's One Stop Shop brings support to Swansea families
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council brought children, young people and families together with support services at a One Stop Shop event at the National Waterfront Museum.
#Castle #CommunitySupport #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council packs half-term with free and low-cost family fun
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is giving families a half-term full of free and low-cost things to do, from Spooks in the City and pumpkin trails to science shows, library crafts and sports camps.
#Castle #Penderry #WhatsOn #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour brings Wales' only dockless e-bike scheme to Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has appointed Voi to run a city-wide e-bike scheme, the only dockless one in Wales, with free first rides and discounts for people on low incomes.
#ActiveTravel #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council helps older residents check if they can claim Pension Credit
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is running a free Pension Credit drop-in at Ty Dewi Sant in Fforestfach on 28 October, where its Financial Inclusion Team will check what older residents can claim.
#Cockett #CostOfLiving #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour's free Christmas buses return for a sixth year
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is bringing back free bus travel for the Christmas Parade weekend and every festive weekend, helping families save on travel and backing city centre businesses.
#Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour
